info.title: xamlfit — static text-fit audit for WPF XAML.
info.description: XamlFit — static text-fit audit for WPF XAML. Computes the pixel budget of every text slot without launching the app: export limits for translators before translation, fail CI on real overflow after.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Computes the pixel budget of every text slot without launching the app.

options.name: --from
options.description:
A font file (.ttf/.otf/.ttc) or a directory of them.
Repeatable. Defaults to the system font directory.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output file (default: xamlfit.fonts.json.gz; a name not ending in .gz writes plain JSON)

options.name: --family
options.description: Only export these families. Repeatable.

options.name: --merge
options.description: Merge into an existing output file instead of replacing it.

options.name: --hinted
options.description:
Windows only: add GDI's hinted widths for 8–48 px, used for
TextFormattingMode="Display" where the font has no hdmx entry.

options.name: --csv
options.description: Write the budget table as CSV (for translation platforms)

options.name: --csv-raw
options.description: Do not prefix formula-like text with ' (byte-exact source

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the full report as JSON

options.name: --sites
options.description: Write one CSV row per text site: status, bound and the reason

options.name: --resx
options.description:
Directory holding .resx files, so resource strings get their
Directory holding .resx files. Repeatable. XAML string

options.name: --metrics
options.description: Metrics file (default: xamlfit.fonts.json.gz or xamlfit.fonts.json next to <root>)

options.name: --min-coverage
options.description: Resolution floor, 0-100. Below it: exit 3.

options.name: --config
options.description: Config file (default: xamlfit.config.json next to <root>).

options.name: --default-font
options.description: Font family assumed where XAML sets none (default: Segoe UI)

options.name: --default-size
options.description: Font size assumed where XAML sets none (default: 12)

options.name: --culture
options.description: Only check these cultures. Repeatable. Default: all found.

options.name: --source-only
options.description: Check only the source language (hard-coded text and neutral

options.name: --pseudo
options.description: No translations: simulate expansion instead (reports only)

options.name: --margin
options.description: Safety margin percent before calling it tight (default 5)

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: 'fail' (default) or 'warn'

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Only report findings not in this baseline

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Write SARIF 2.1.0 (GitHub code scanning)

options.name: --md
options.description: Write a Markdown report (for a PR comment)

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: Also print MSBuild diagnostics on stdout, so Visual Studio
